title: Pure Digital Bug
summary: Pure Digital Bug Xyz build with untagged Insect Xyz Monsters, generic Links, and staples. Digital Bugs are Level 3 LIGHT Insects that can only be used as Xyz Material for Insect monsters, triggering their effects whenever they change from Attack Position to Defense Position.

summary.title: Starters
points: Digital Bug Websolder changes a face-up Attack Position monster you control to Defense Position to Special Summon a Level 3 Insect from your hand in Defense Position.
Digital Bug Centibit Special Summons a Level 3 Insect from the Deck in Defense Position once per turn when changed from Attack to Defense Position.
Digital Bug LEDybug adds a Level 3 Insect from the Deck to your hand once per turn when changed from Attack to Defense Position.
Digital Bug Registrider Special Summons itself from the hand when you Normal Summon a Level 3 Insect and can raise both monsters to Level 5 or Level 7.

summary.title: Opening: Centibit or LEDybug + Websolder / Registrider
steps: Normal Summon Digital Bug Centibit or Digital Bug LEDybug; if you have Digital Bug Registrider in hand, Special Summon Registrider immediately and optionally set both monsters' Levels to 5 or 7.

With Digital Bug Websolder on the field, switch Centibit or LEDybug from Attack to Defense Position to Special Summon a Level 3 Insect from your hand and trigger Centibit to summon from the Deck or LEDybug to search.
Overlay your Level 3 Insects into Digital Bug Scaradiator or Number 3: Cicada King, or rank up directly into Digital Bug Corebage and Digital Bug Rhinosebus.

summary.title: Inherited Xyz Material Effects & Cocoondenser
summary.text: Each Main Deck Digital Bug passes a bonus effect to an Insect Xyz Monster summoned using it as material: Websolder switches all opposing monsters to Defense Position and sets their DEF to 0 on Xyz Summon, Centibit lets the Xyz attack all Defense Position monsters once each, LEDybug draws a card whenever the Xyz destroys a monster by battle, and Registrider boosts the Xyz by 1000 ATK and DEF. Digital Bug Cocoondenser switches itself from Attack to Defense Position to revive a Level 3 Insect from the GY, and grants piercing damage as Xyz Material.

summary.title: Insect Xyz Bosses & Fill
points: Digital Bug Scaradiator (Rank 3) detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to change an opponent's monster's battle position and negate its effects for the turn, and attaches a destroyed monster as material.
Digital Bug Corebage (Rank 5, or ranked up over a Rank 3 or 4 Insect Xyz by detaching 2 materials) detaches a material to shuffle an opponent's Defense Position monster into the Deck.

Digital Bug Rhinosebus (Rank 7, or ranked up over a Rank 5 or 6 Insect Xyz) inflicts piercing damage and detaches a material as a Quick Effect to destroy the opponent's monster(s) with the highest DEF.

Number 3: Cicada King negates a monster effect on the field and summons an Insect on a battle position change, while Number 20: Giga-Brilliant and Number 28: Titanic Moth round out the Insect Xyz lineup. Because the Main Deck only has five Digital Bug monster names, handtraps and staple Spells fill the remaining slots.

main: Newest: summons itself on a Level 3 Insect Normal Summon; makes both Level 5 or 7.
Flips a monster to Defense to summon a Level 3 Insect from the hand.
Summons a Level 3 Insect from the Deck when flipped to Defense.
Searches a Level 3 Insect when flipped to Defense.
Flips itself to Defense to revive a Level 3 Insect.
extra: Rank 3: flips and negates a monster on either turn.
Rank 5, or over a Rank 3 or 4 Insect: shuffles a Defense monster into the Deck.
Rank 7, or over a Rank 5 or 6 Insect: destroys their highest-DEF monster.
Untagged Rank 3 Insect: summons an Insect on a position change; negates a monster.
Untagged Rank 3 Insect: pumps your monsters.
Untagged Rank 7 Insect: attacks directly and burns per card in hand.
